title: castilleja affinis var. linariifolia
intro: Castilleja affinis var. linariifolia, commonly known as Mountain Indian paintbrush, is a perennial plant species in the family Orobanchaceae. It is a hemiparasitic plant that obtains some of its nutrients by parasitizing the roots of other plants. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is said to help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Indian paintbrush include iridoid glycosides, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
